criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: People
categories.definition: Individuals notable for their contributions to fields such as arts, sports, politics, history, or other human endeavors.

categories.name: Organizations
categories.definition: Groups of people structured as companies, institutions, government bodies, or other collective entities.

categories.name: Geographical features
categories.definition: Natural or physical features of the Earth's surface such as mountains, bodies of water, and landforms.

categories.name: Villages
categories.definition: Small human settlements or communities located within a specific administrative region.

categories.name: Films
categories.definition: Motion pictures or cinematic works created for entertainment, documentary, or artistic purposes.

categories.name: Albums
categories.definition: Collections of audio recordings, typically music, issued as a single item on various media.

categories.name: Plants
categories.definition: Living organisms belonging to the kingdom Plantae, including trees, shrubs, flowers, and ferns.

categories.name: Animals
categories.definition: Living organisms belonging to the kingdom Animalia, including insects, birds, mammals, and fish.

categories.name: Vehicles
categories.definition: Machines used for transporting people or cargo, such as automobiles, aircraft, and ships.

categories.name: Books
categories.definition: Written or printed works of fiction or non-fiction, typically published as physical volumes.

categories.name: Schools
categories.definition: Educational institutions dedicated to teaching students at the primary, secondary, or higher levels.

categories.name: Buildings and structures
categories.definition: Man-made constructions such as historic buildings, religious sites, and infrastructure.

categories.name: Periodicals
categories.definition: Publications issued at regular intervals, such as newspapers, magazines, and academic journals.
